科研.title: Automatic Construction of Strong Simple Baselines
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.40700v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To rigorously establish the value of a novel deep learning method, it must be compared against appropriate baselines. As deep learning has become increasingly common in the physical and life sciences, there have been numerous cases in which apparent progress has turned out to be an artifact of omitted or missing baselines. In this work, we investigate whether this problem can be mitigated by using large language models to automate the construction of baselines. We assemble 36 supervised classification and regression tasks from peer-reviewed studies in Nature, Science, and Cell-family journals that investigate novel deep learning methods for scientific applications. We then use a language model to construct simple baselines for each task. These automatically constructed baselines are strong, recovering a median of 95.5% (mean 85.7%) of the gap between a trivial predictor and the score of the deep learning model. The median simple baseline matches or exceeds the performance of the deep learning model in 12 studies. We further examine the variation across scientific domains and publication venues and we characterize the effects of test-time compute and access to different levels of study context. As human peer review has struggled to keep up with the rapidly increasing volume of research articles in recent years, our results suggest that automated baseline construction is a practical and scalable check on deep learning contributions in the physical and life sciences.

科研.title: Bayesian Distribution System State Estimation with Flow Matching
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.40728v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Medium-voltage feeders have few real-time measurements, so distribution system state estimation (DSSE) rests on pseudo-measurements of the secondary substations, a prior in Bayesian terms. Weighted least squares keeps the power flow exact but reduces this prior to a mean and variance, while supervised deep learning estimators also learn the power flow and are tied to one measurement set. We propose PoSE (posterior sampling for state estimation), which keeps the Bayesian structure of DSSE and learns only what the distribution system operator does not know, namely the distribution of substation injections, modelled by a neural network trained with flow matching on historical data. The power flow equations, grid topology and measurements enter only at sampling, through a noise-aware Kalman-type correction. The neural network therefore never approximates the power flow, but every posterior sample is a physically consistent operating point, and one trained prior serves any measurement set, noise level and topology. On the IEEE 33-bus feeder, PoSE lowers the probabilistic injection error (CRPS) by 6.7-7.5% against a full-covariance Gaussian prior in all 12 tested settings. It provides reliable uncertainty: the 90% intervals contain the true injection almost exactly as often as exact posterior samples would, whereas those of supervised estimators contain it in only 37-78% of cases. On the 240-bus unbalanced three-phase Iowa feeder, it gives the lowest injection, voltage and branch-current errors of all estimators. A fast variant matches this accuracy at 0.2-0.6s per snapshot and, without retraining, beats Gaussian priors and retrained supervised estimators on seven reconfigured topologies.

科研.title: Don't Just Impute, Detect: Task-Aware Diffusion Pipelines for Edge Anomaly Detection
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.40732v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) edge pipelines routinely lose contiguous blocks of multi-sensor data to network dropouts and hardware faults. The standard remedy is a disjointed "impute-then-detect" pipeline whose imputer is trained only for Mean Squared Error (MSE). Such an imputer fills a missing block with the most probable normal pattern: a partially observed anomaly is smoothed back toward normality, and boundary artifacts on normal data raise false alarms. We call this imputation bias and propose the Task-Aware Diffusion Refiner (TADR), a conditional diffusion refiner trained against the loss landscape of a frozen downstream detector. Because back-propagating through the sampling trajectory is intractable, the task-aware terms act on the one-step clean-window estimate that the noise prediction already yields, so training costs no more than plain diffusion training. Under strict Point-to-Point evaluation over five seeds with paired significance tests, TADR raises F1 by $0.338$ over the unrefined detector on SMD ($p = 0.0015$), and the anomaly enhancement objective alone contributes $0.463$ in ablation. We also characterise when the method helps: the gain tracks the continuous, mutually redundant channels available and the anomaly evidence the outage removes, and it is absent on telemetry datasets dominated by one-hot command channels and on PSM. At ten sampling steps TADR runs in $41.4$ ms per window on a single CPU core, sustaining about $24$ concurrent 1 Hz streams from a $4.03$ MB model. Code and per-seed results are available at https://github.com/int-park422/TADR.

科研.title: Unsupervised Feature Selection Using Local Intrinsic Dimensionality -- Extended Version
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.40736v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High dimensionality degrades both the efficiency and the effectiveness of learning algorithms, and in many applications no class labels are available to guide dimensionality reduction. This paper proposes LIDFS, an unsupervised feature selection method based on Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (LID). The method builds on the formal equivalence between LID and the indiscriminability of distance measures. The data matrix is transposed so that each feature is treated as a point, and the LID of each feature is estimated by maximum likelihood from the distances to its $k$ nearest neighboring features. Features with lower LID exhibit greater local discriminability and receive higher importance scores. A refinement step then retains one representative per feature neighborhood and demotes locally redundant features. The result is a complete ranking from which any number of features can be selected without rerunning the procedure. LIDFS does not use any information about labels or the number of classes, and runs in $\mathcal{O}(d^2 n)$ time for $n$ instances and $d$ features. LIDFS is compared with classic and state-of-the-art methods and a random baseline on 23 high-dimensional datasets, the classic benchmark collection. The evaluation uses classification accuracy and AUC with five downstream classifiers, as well as clustering accuracy and normalized mutual information, over both full and aggressive selection ranges. LIDFS ranks first in the supervised evaluations and first or tied second in the clustering-based evaluations. It belongs to the top statistical group together with methods that require the number of classes, and it runs faster than its closest competitor. Several recent methods, by contrast, fail to outperform the random baseline. A sensitivity analysis shows that small neighborhood sizes yield the best results.

科研.title: SKFitter: Symmetry resolved Slater Koster tight-binding models from first principles for s, p, d and f electrons, spin orbit coupling and magnetism
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.40729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constructing accurate and physically interpretable tight binding (TB) Hamiltonians from first principles calculations remains challenging, particularly for materials exhibiting complex orbital hybridization, spin orbit coupling (SOC), and magnetic order. SKFitter is an open-source Python framework for constructing and optimizing symmetry resolved Slater Koster TB models directly from density functional theory (DFT) calculations performed using Quantum ESPRESSO or VASP. The framework supports s to f orbitals, incorporates on site SOC and site resolved magnetic exchange interactions, and accommodates both orthogonal and nonorthogonal basis. A central feature is the symmetry resolved parameterization of orbital manifolds, which allows independent two centre hopping integrals between symmetry allowed orbital groups and across distinct neighbour shells. SKFitter also identifies missing orbital contributions and guide systematic basis set refinement and optimizes parameters through weights. The resulting Hamiltonian can be used to evaluate anomalous (AHC) and spin Hall conductivities (SHC), and topological invariants. We demonstrate the framework using eight representative materials spanning semimetals, semiconductors, transition metals, f-electron compounds, and magnetic systems. Symmetry resolved models achieve band energy errors of 9 to 41 meV within 1 eV of the Fermi level. The fitted Hamiltonians reproduce characteristic features of the SHC response of Pt, the SOC dependence of the AHC of Fe, and the momentum dependent altermagnetic spin splitting of MnTe without any altermagnet specific interaction. For EuMn2Bi2, projection guided orbital refinement reduces the near Fermi level fitting error from 120 to 32 meV. Together, these results establish SKFitter as a flexible and reproducible framework for developing symmetry consistent, physically interpretable TB models of complex materials.

科研.title: Thermal Stability and Structural Relaxation Kinetics of Commercially Pure Titanium
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.40737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work explores the structural relaxation of cryorolled commercially pure titanium subjected to subsequent annealing.Nanostructured specimens with an average grain size of ~50 nm were produced by plastic deformation via cryogenic rolling at 100 K to a true strain of 1.20, followed by annealing at 425 K, 525 K, 725 K, and 945 K. Microstructural evolution was examined using electron microscopy and X-ray diffraction. Cryogenic rolling was found to induce pronounced grain fragmentation, with coherent scattering regions (CSRs) of 30-50 nm dominating the substructure. X-ray diffraction analysis revealed that annealing drives crystallite growth: a slight increase at 525 K, accelerated coarsening at 725 K, and complete recrystallization at 945 K. The kinetics of grain growth follow the classical Lifshitz-Slyozov-Wagner model, with a growth exponent of ~4, reflecting the role of triple junctions and defect-controlled boundary diffusion. The activation energy, estimated at ~97 kJ/mol, corresponds to typical values for grain boundary diffusion in {\alpha}-Ti, confirming that cryogenic deformation produces a highly non-equilibrium microstructure whose relaxation is strongly temperature dependent.

科研.title: Spectral properties of orthorhombic KSbOSiO$_4$ crystals: studies of infrared, visible and ultraviolet radiation absorption, Raman scattering, cathodoluminescen
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.40739v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystals of orthorhombic KSbOSiO$_4$ (KSS) are often found to synthesize in glass of historical and artistic articles. For instance, these crystallites in the glass of turquoise Bohemian seed beads are known to play a significant role in the process of internal-stress driven corrosion of the glass causing deterioration and destruction of bead embroidered museum exhibits, especially articles made in the early 19th century. In art materials science, KSS has been known since the mid-2010s only for its destructive effects on historical glass objects, but as an optical material it has long been studied. KSS belongs to the group of compounds isomorphic to KTiOPO$_4$ (KTP) and, like other compounds from this group, has anomalies in dielectric constant. The article presents the results of a study of orthorhombic KSS crystals using a number of spectroscopic techniques. IR absorption and diffuse reflection spectra of KSS in the spectral range from 50 to 4000~cm$^{-1}$, its Raman spectrum, its absorption spectrum in the range from near infrared to ultraviolet as well as its cathodoluminescence and photoluminescence spectra are investigated. The constituent peaks of the spectral bands are analyzed and their properties are summarized in tables; the allowed direct and indirect band gaps of KSS are determined. The presented data are necessary both for the correct spectral analysis of historical and artistic glass and enamels, during the production of which this substance was sometimes synthesized in glass, and for a more in-depth study of crystals of the KTP group.

科研.title: Kibble-Zurek dynamics beyond the thermodynamic limit
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.40755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM) predicts the universal scaling of topological defect densities generated during continuous phase transitions, a result derived in the thermodynamic limit of homogeneous systems. Yet real materials are intrinsically finite and heterogeneous, raising the question of how nonequilibrium universality survives outside this idealized limit. Here we establish an ensemble-finite-size extension of the KZM that describes critical dynamics in collections of independent finite subsystems with distributed sizes. We test this framework using a polycrystalline model system undergoing a symmetry-breaking transition. We find that the density of topological vortices follows an apparent power law with an exponent approximately half that observed in single crystals. This reduced exponent emerges quantitatively from averaging over the experimentally measured grain-size distribution, without fitting to the measured vortex densities. Our results demonstrate that finite-size effects do not simply suppress KZ scaling but reorganize it into an emergent statistical scaling regime governed by system-size heterogeneity. This establishes microstructure and geometry as control parameters of nonequilibrium critical dynamics and provides a general strategy to engineer scaling behaviour in complex materials.

科研.title: Complete Au-free Metallization Platform for UWBG Al$_{0.65}$Ga$_{0.35}$N channel MOS-HEMTs using Ti/Al/Ti Ohmic Contacts and Refractory TiN/Pt Gates
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.40993v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Au-free ohmic contacts and refractory gate stacks are critical for integrating ultra-wide-bandgap (UWBG) Al-rich AlGaN transistors with Si-CMOS technology. In this work, we demonstrate, to our knowledge, the first complete Au-free metallization platform for Al$_{0.65}$Ga$_{0.35}$N-channel MOS-HEMTs, combining electron-beam-evaporated and sputtered Ti/Al/Ti ohmic contacts with sputtered TiN and Pt gate metals. The Ti/Al/Ti contacts achieved a contact resistance of approximately 7.5--7.7 $\Omega\cdot$mm while being fully Au-free. This contact resistance is achieved using a 600 $^\circ$C anneal, substantially below the 850--950 $^\circ$C typically required for Au-capped Ti/Al/X/Au contacts on Al-rich AlGaN, indicating a reduced thermal budget and improved compatibility with silicon-CMOS foundries. TiN gates deliver drain-current density up to 450 mA/mm at $V_{\mathrm{th}} = -13$ V, whereas Pt gates shift $V_{\mathrm{th}}$ to -2.5 V with a reduced current drive of 220 mA/mm, reflecting the effects of gate work function. TiN-gated devices exhibit lower current degradation under pulsed operation and a higher critical breakdown field ($E_{\mathrm{c}} \approx 3.5$ MV/cm) than Pt-gated devices ($E_{\mathrm{c}} \approx 2.98$ MV/cm), measured without field plating at $L_{\mathrm{GD}} = 2.3$ $\mu$m. Collectively, these results establish a low-thermal-budget, fully Au-free, CMOS-compatible metallization platform for high-performance Al-rich AlGaN UWBG power electronics.

科研.title: Wideband Near- and Far-Field Double-Bounce Physical Optics via Co-Area Range Profile Extraction
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.41812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wideband evaluation of the Radar Cross Section (RCS) and the underlying range profile of a target, including its secondary double-bounce fields, remains a computational bottleneck even for modern high-frequency solvers. This paper presents a framework for evaluating the wideband range profile under the Physical Optics (PO) approximation without repeated frequency-domain iterations. Using phase level-set integration via the Co-Area formula, we project the single- and double-bounce scattered fields into frequency-independent Geometric Range Profiles (GRPs), valid in both the far-field and near-field regions. The approach builds on the Radon Transform interpretation of Physical Optics scattering. Unlike point-sampling methods, our discrete implementation bins the profile in range while retaining a complex-valued representation that encodes sub-bin phase corrections, so the field can be evaluated accurately at frequencies well beyond the nominal mesh resolution. We also derive a corresponding time-domain formulation for the scattered transient response to analytic incident pulses. We further show that the classical second-derivative area law for far-field transient scattering extends into the near field as a two-term expression in the derivatives of an isochrone projected area, which reduces to the classical law as the additional induction term decays with range.

科研.title: Magnetic Johnson noise from arbitrarily shaped conductors: experimental validation of the fluctuation-dissipation finite-element method
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.42113v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic Johnson noise--magnetic noise caused by thermal current fluctuations in conducting materials--can interfere with measurements and limit their sensitivity. As the sensitivity of experiments increases, it becomes increasingly important to accurately estimate the magnetic Johnson noise from experimental components with complex shapes during both the design and analysis phases. A particularly powerful approach is to combine the fluctuation-dissipation theorem with finite-element calculations. This versatile approach can be used to calculate the magnetic Johnson noise from conductors of arbitrary geometry for a wide range of frequencies and for magnetic field detectors with general geometries, such as a finite-sized loop or a gradiometer. Using a SQUID gradiometer array, we measured the magnetic Johnson noise from conductors with complex geometries and compared the results with calculations performed using this method. The calculations reproduce both the measured noise amplitude and its frequency dependence, providing an experimental validation of this method. We also performed a detailed analysis of how the geometry and material parameters affect the frequency dependence of magnetic Johnson noise.

科研.title: Intensity-Domain Demultiplexing of Orbital Angular Momentum Channels for Optical Communication
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.41259v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) multiplexing has been limited in practice by the complexity and optical loss of the elements that separate the channels at the receiver side. Here we adopt the azimuthal harmonics of OAM petal patterns as the demultiplexing basis, which makes the receiver the optical counterpart of the circular antenna arrays used in radio OAM links: the petal pattern of topological charge $\ell$ carries a single azimuthal harmonic of order $2\ell$, so one Fourier transform of the azimuthal intensity profile returns every channel, without gratings or mode sorters. The petals are formed by projecting a vector vortex beam from a single q-plate onto a linear polarization. A two-channel system at 515 nm with a 16-position circular photoreceiver array reaches 5.2 Gb/s below the forward error correction threshold, 2.6 Gb/s per channel from a 1.4 GHz photoreceiver.

科技.title: OpenAI CEO 奥尔特曼密访韩国，深化与三星、SK 集团 AI 芯片与数据中心合作
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 2 日消息，OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）于上周末对韩国进行了一次未提前对外公布的访问。他与三星高管进行了会面，据报道还同 SK 集团会长崔泰源（Chey Tae-won）举行了会谈，进一步深化和韩国头部芯片厂商已有的合作关系。 三星在周六表示，奥尔特曼在首尔南部的龙仁市，会见了三星旗下电子、金融、生物科技等子公司的约五十名高管。 三星称，会谈内容包括人工智能技术进展、潜在商业机会，以及这项技术对企业决策和运营带来的影响。 韩国媒体报道，奥尔特曼还在周六与 SK 集团会长崔泰源共进午餐，SK 海力士、SK 电讯的高层一同出席。 当地媒体消息称，双方可能围绕人工智能芯片与数据中心展开合作磋商，其中包括现有高带宽内存供货方案以及人工智能数据中心建设计划。参会各方没有披露会谈细节。 据IT之家了解，奥尔特曼曾在 2025 年 10 月到访韩国，当时他会见了韩国总统李在明、三星电子会长李在镕以及 SK 集团会长崔泰源，并宣布和三星、SK 集团达成合作，这是 OpenAI“星门”计划的一部分。 OpenAI 的星门计划旨在在全球范围内扩建人工智能基础设施，韩国通过合作参与其中，合作方向集中在先进存储芯片供货以及人工智能数据中心建设。 根据相关协议，三星电子和 SK 海力士拟定计划，提升先进存储芯片产能；OpenAI 及其韩国合作方则同意探讨在韩国落地人工智能数据中心项目。 OpenAI 表示，韩国在人工智能落地准备度方面位居全球前列，同时有大量公私资金投入用于提升产业竞争力，这也是 OpenAI 选择扩大在韩布局的原因。 三星方面称，在此次访问之前，奥尔特曼还曾在 7 月于旧金山的 OpenAI 总部和三星电子会长李在镕会面。 当地媒体报道，奥尔特曼已于周六离开韩国。

科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 2 日消息，近日，有网友分享了宋雨琦在演唱会时的照片， 随后她手上佩戴的手表被认出是即将发布的 OPPO Watch 5 。 据IT之家此前报道， OPPO Watch 5 智能手表目前已现身官网开启预约 。官方公布的参考图片显示，这款手表为方形设计，右上角还配备了旋钮功能键。 博主 @数码闲聊站 爆料称，已上手绿厂小方表（预计指 OPPO Watch 5）。 该产品主打“同档最薄”，厚度大概率 9.2mm 。据称，OPPO Watch 5 主打轻薄超续航，配备超亮屏，采用航天级铝合金中框设计，整机质感在线。 延伸阅读 据 OPPO 智能生态产品总监乔家栋预告，OPPO Watch 5 将在 2026 年 11 月正式亮相。 该新品预计将与 OPPO Reno 17 系列手机、OPPO Pad Air 6 平板电脑一同在此次发布会上登场。 据官方预热信息，OPPO Watch 5 重量不到 27g，比一只口红还要轻，厚度约为 9.2mm。爆料信息还提到，该产品定位估计在千元档，相较同类竞品更为轻薄，并配备极窄四等边屏幕，主打女性运动健康与燃脂功能。 回顾产品线，OPPO Watch 数字系列此前一直采用方形表盘设计，直到 Watch S 系列的推出。该系列最新款的 OPPO Watch 4 Pro 目前官网显示“已售罄”，其搭载骁龙 W5 可穿戴旗舰芯片，支持独立 eSIM，可下载微信手表版、支付宝、QQ 等应用。 OPPO Watch 4 Pro 于 2023 年 8 月 29 日发布，采用精钢表壳和陶瓷底盖，配备骁龙 W5 + BES 2700 双芯、2GB 运行内存及 LTPO 常亮屏，售价 2299 元起。

科技.title: 极星 Polestar 2 停产，继任车型明年推出
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 2 日消息，据汽车媒体 AutoCar 今天报道，极星 Polestar 2 车型已经正式停产，六年间累计销量超 19 万辆。 IT之家从原报道获悉， 极星的中国、挪威和瑞典工厂已不再接受 Polestar 2 订单 。不过该车型目前仍在英国销售，库存足以在二代车型上市之前满足市场需求。 自 2020 年年中上市以来，Polestar 2 全球累计销量已超 19 万辆，其中 4 万辆销往英国。如今 Polestar 2 的销量已经被 Polestar 4 跨界车超越。 极星已在此前展示新一代 Polestar 2 的外观设计。新车长度略长于现款的 4.6m，看起来更加年轻。极星 CEO Michael Lohscheller 对此表示，新一代 Polestar 2 将保留现款的所有优点，并解决以前车型的一些问题。

科技.title: ​传苹果逐步淘汰非触控 MacBook Pro；谷歌 AI 被指正切断互联网流量；赛力斯：问界全面进入欧洲市场
科技.summary: 苹果 CEO：不会为了做 AI 而做产品 苹果 CEO 约翰·特努斯近日接受采访时，为苹果当前在人工智能领域的布局进行辩护。过去几年，外界常认为苹果在 AI 赛道落后，尤其是苹果推迟推出更强版本的 Siri，该功能直到今年夏天才正式上线。 特努斯是苹果资深高管，9 月初正式出任 CEO。他承认「每个人都有自己的看法」，但坚称：「我对我们现在所处的阶段很满意。」 特努斯补充，苹果一定会在新产品中运用人工智能，但他表示：「我们不想为了做 AI 而推出 AI。如果我们做得好，用户不会去思考这个功能到底是 AI 实现的，还是传统软件实现的。重点在于，我们是否打造出用户真正喜爱的产品。」（来源：环球市场播报） OpenAI、谷歌、微软和 Anthropic 联手推行 AI 数据抓取退出标准 11 月 1 日消息，OpenAI、谷歌、微软以及 Anthropic 近日宣布将采用一项新标准，内容发布方可以借助该标准选择拒绝 AI 抓取自家网站内容。借助这项管控机制，内容发布方可以一次性向多家 AI 企业统一申明自身针对 AI 模型训练的内容使用偏好，而不必为每家企业单独设置规则。 该标准由 Anthropic 技术负责人 Kevin Kelley 向互联网工程任务组（IETF）提出，并将集成在网站的 robots.txt 文件中。 长期以来，robots.txt 文件用于告知网络爬虫哪些网站内容允许抓取、哪些禁止抓取，适用场景包含搜索索引、网页归档以及 AI 模型训练。目前，网站必须向每一家 AI 企业分别单独声明自己的 AI 训练相关内容使用偏好。在此背景下，各类 AI 爬虫持续抓取网站内容、将网页素材输入 AI 模型训练，内容发布方正为此焦头烂额。（来源：新浪财经） 苹果计划在 2027 年逐步淘汰高端非触控 MacBook Pro 苹果刚刚为 MacBook Pro 引入触控屏幕，但这一变化可能只是产品线调整的开始。根据彭博社记者马克·古尔曼（Mark Gurman）在其 Power On 通讯中的消息，苹果计划在 2027 年推出第二代触控屏 MacBook Pro 时，逐步取消现有的高端非触控版本，届时除了入门级 14 英寸机型之外，MacBook Pro 产品线可能将全面转向触控屏设计。 苹果在 2026 年 10 月底推出了首批配备触控屏的 MacBook Pro，提供 14 英寸和 16 英寸两种尺寸，采用名为 PROLED XDR 的新型显示屏，并搭载 M5 Pro 或 M5 Max 处理器。这是苹果首次在 MacBook Pro 上正式引入触控操作，意味着公司坚持多年的笔记本电脑不需要触摸屏这一产品理念出现了明显转变。 当然，目前关于 2027 年产品线调整的消息仍然属于爆料，并非苹果正式公布的产品规划。（来源：cnbeta） Google AI Mode 正在切断互联网流量 Google 正在改变人们使用互联网的方式，而这种变化可能给整个网络生态系统带来深远影响。随着人工智能搜索逐渐取代传统搜索结果页面，用户越来越习惯直接从 AI 生成的摘要和对话中获取答案，而不是点击链接访问具体网站。 对于长期依赖 Google 搜索流量获取用户的企业和网络出版商而言，这意味着一个曾经稳定的流量来源正在迅速萎缩。 美国社交平台 Reddit 最近公布的第三季度财报，成为这一趋势的一个典型案例。公司联合创始人兼首席执行官史蒂夫·霍夫曼（Steve Huffman）在财报电话会议上直言，用户仍然需要 Reddit 上的内容，但 Google 已经不像过去那样将用户引导至 Reddit。 霍夫曼表示，Google 仍在大量抓取 Reddit 上的内容，说明用户对这些信息的需求并没有消失。真正发生变化的是 Google 的 AI 搜索模式：它能够直接回答用户的问题，却不再像传统搜索那样为内容提供者带来相应的网站访问量。（来源：网易） OpenAI 考虑将数据中心重新包装为「AI 算力园区」 11 月 2 日消息，据外媒 Axios 昨天报道，OpenAI 正准备在周二美国中期选举结束后，发起大规模公关宣传活动。 OpenAI 首席全球事务官克里斯 · 莱汉（Chris Lehane）对此表示，此次中期选举将成为 2028 年总统大选的「预告片」。未来，人工智能将成为大选的核心议题。 莱汉提到，他们计划制定 AI 发展速度限制；并寻找方法，让人们认识到 AI 如何赋能日常生活；推动美国参与制定全球标准；以及将数据中心重新包装为「AI 算力园区」。 莱汉认为，AI 公司与民众就数据中心展开的讨论将是「良好且健康的对话」。此前因数据中心建设争议不断发酵，亚马逊和微软宣布，与地方政府谈判相关项目时，将不再使用保密协议。（来源：IT 之家） 我国人工智能推理数据量首超训练数据量 11 月 1 日消息，据央视新闻报道，中国电子信息产业发展研究院（简称「赛迪研究院」，英文缩写 CCID）发布的《新域新质创新发展十大趋势》显示，我国人工智能推理数据量首次超过训练数据量，标志着我国人工智能从模型训练研发阶段迈入规模化产业应用阶段。 数据显示，截至 2026 年 6 月，日均词元调用量超过 175 万亿，相比 2024 年年初增长 1000 多倍。顶尖大模型的迭代周期也从过去的几个月压缩到几周甚至几天，人工智能正从「喂模型」的实验室阶段，全面转入「用模型」的产业落地阶段。（来源：央视新闻） 赛力斯：问界将全面进入欧洲市场，公司不参与价格战和规模内卷 11 月 1 日消息，赛力斯 10 月 31 日发布投资者关系活动记录表，其中回答了「公司在问界的整体经营思路上有什么样的思考？对下一步业务发展有什么规划？」。 据其介绍，问界坚定做全球高端品牌。目前问界全系正推进欧盟 WVTA E1 整车型式认证，验证周期长、环节多，是高端车进入欧洲市场的必经门槛。公司坚持按最高标准走完全程，确保产品以合规、可靠的状态出海。 随着认证与渠道建设推进，问界将全面进入欧洲市场，稳步迈向海外销量占比三分之一的目标。 该公司还提到坚持以盈利质量为核心导向。公司不参与价格战和规模内卷，不追求无盈利支撑的销量规模，坚持走高端化经营路线。 该公司透露，问界已累计交付 120 万辆高端智能电动汽车，拥有超过 120 万的问界用户。（来源：凤凰网） 国产武侠游戏《影之刃零》Steam 峰值在线玩家 83 万创新高，连续四天走高 11 月 1 日消息，SteamDB 平台显示，《影之刃零》Steam 峰值在线玩家数达到 83 万创下新高，这部国产武侠游戏在线人数连续四天走高。 国产 3A 游戏《影之刃零》已登陆 PS5 与 PC 平台，国区数字标准版售价 268 元，数字豪华版售价 328 元。PS5 实体光碟将于 2027 年推出。该作由灵游坊自主研发发行，采用虚幻引擎 5 打造，定位黑暗武侠题材第三人称动作冒险与单机动作 RPG，把中国武术与蒸汽朋克融合为功夫朋克风格，美术深沉黑暗，主打快节奏高速战斗。 在《影之刃零》中，玩家将化身心脏遭受重创的剑客，在仅余六十六天的生命里，逃亡于刀光剑影和腥风血雨之间，并粉碎一桩笼罩在整个武林上方的惊天阴谋。在失序末法的武林中以身证道，以命寻心。战斗系统提供 30 余种主武器与 20 多门夺自败者的奇诡武装，连击流畅、易上手而难精通，借助全新动作捕捉逐帧还原真实技击，以电影化演绎呈现中国功夫。（来源：东方财富） 酷态科 30 号笔记本适配器发售：自带主动风冷、可为游戏本提供 360W 输出，499 元 11 月 1 日消息，酷态科旗下 30 号笔记本适配器现已在京东发售，该产品带有主动风冷，可为游戏本提供 360W 输出，定价为 499 元。 该适配器尺寸为 84.5 x 85.5 x 36.6 mm，匹配三脚新国标半包胶插脚，产品包装内附赠收纳袋，方便日常存放与携带。适配器采用 5525 标准 DC 接口，附赠 20 余款转接头以及约 0.5m 和 1.5m 长度的编织 DC 线，适用多种机型场景。 官方强调，该适配器使用 GaN 芯片，首发 MPS 图腾柱无桥 PFC 架构。通过去除传统 PFC 电路的二极管整流桥，有效降低了导通损耗。该设计使整机满载效率达到约 96%，整机功率密度提升约 109%。同时适配器采用主动风冷散热系统，内部风扇最高转速可达 13300 RPM。（来源：IT 之家） 「幽灵学生」借助 AI 骗取助学金，美国调查揭露跨国教育欺诈网络 美国司法部近日公布了一起涉及人工智能技术的教育资助欺诈案件。检方已在内布拉斯加州、弗吉尼亚州和新泽西州起诉五名涉案人员，并查扣超过 75 万美元的加密货币资产。 调查显示，一个与肯尼亚相关的犯罪网络利用被盗身份信息伪造学生身份，通过人工智能完成课程作业、模拟在线上课，从而骗取联邦助学金。 检方表示，犯罪分子利用窃取的美国公民个人身份信息注册虚假学生账户，申请联邦学生资助并入读大学及社区学院。为了避免被学校发现，这些虚构学生会借助人工智能自动填写申请材料、完成课程作业，甚至在部分情况下制造出真实学生参与在线课堂的假象。 调查发现，部分涉案金额相当可观。根据司法部披露的信息，其中一名被告利用多家金融机构账户接收了超过 700 笔欺诈性助学金退款，总金额约 144 万美元。另有涉案人员通过 300 多个虚假学生账户相关资金流获得超过 100 万美元存款。 联邦调查局表示，目前已经确认类似「幽灵学生」计划造成的损失超过 3200 万美元，而实际损失金额很可能远高于这一数字。（来源：网易）
